I am writing to refer this patient under the skin suspected cancer pathway. He first noticed a changing pigmented lesion on his left shoulder approximately three months ago. On examination the lesion measures 14mm and has an irregular border, with asymmetry and uneven pigmentation -- areas of dark brown, black, and pale pink visible within the same lesion. He describes it as a bleeding mole that bleeds when it catches on clothing approximately weekly.

He has fair skin and significant sun exposure including childhood sunburn episodes. No family history of melanoma. No previous skin cancer.
